scope: Evidence reuse decisions, open-risk handling and pre-freeze evidence/implementation assigned to N10.3-N10.7. No new experiment or flight was run.

matrix.limit: Unarmed low-speed support motion, no roll excitation; 8.4 m/344.8 sim s below 16 m/600 s. RMSE is not a hard pointwise bound.
matrix.decision: Reuse as diagnostics; N10.3 measures full-length live low-speed task and raw-VIO error; N16 remains the formal 10-minute complete-load task.

matrix.limit: #02 and #04/#05 causes remain unknown; N09 repeat03 high-cost frame is unexplained.
matrix.decision: Keep all health/freshness limits. Never call these false alarms or repaired; a cost/freshness trip must cancel/exit, land safely, and count FAIL.

matrix.limit: Idle map/fusion, not flight or terminal error.
matrix.decision: Reuse 3 idle epochs and retain <=0.4 sim s map-age guard; N10.6 verifies live parameters/identity/freshness.

anomalies: Sampled expected-free ray-reference cells classified raw occupied: wall layout 13, 5, 3 across its three snapshots; corridor layout 276, 4, 2. These are retained as false-occupied/voxel-vote conflicts, not hidden by inflation.
Corridor snapshot 3 occupied-set Jaccard to snapshot 2 was 0.349 and its measured central-wall median shift was 0.0982 m, close to one 0.1 m voxel; surface error remained below one voxel.
Ray-reference sampling is a deterministic lower-bound subset of fused depth frames and pixels; it does not claim exhaustive whole-map visibility coverage.
The exact evaluator cannot overwrite the original root-owned capture files as the unprivileged workspace user; validation used temporary copies containing the paired stack/session evidence.

matrix.limit: No original metric threshold; one corridor snapshot moved about a 0.1 m voxel; sampled geometry is not whole-map flight clearance.
matrix.decision: Derive/test a one-voxel candidate map-error bound in N10.3; preserve raw unknown/anomalies; evaluate physical body clearance independently by truth/contact.

matrix.limit: N05 known-free scan is old rule; N06 did not execute curves and does not qualify obstacle flight under official_ego.
matrix.decision: Do not reset old N05/N06 status or reinstate raw-free prerequisite. N10.6 checks current policy; N12-N14 cover formal obstacle flights.

matrix.limit: Old runtime identity; N10 does not change HRT mapping.
matrix.decision: Do not rerun N07; capture clock/telemetry in N10.6 and investigate only on regression.

matrix.limit: Short low-speed forward paths; no general vector cap, obstacle/return, or long route. Stop distance is along-track, not radial clearance.
matrix.decision: Final candidate retains <=0.1 m/s per-axis, <=0.25 m/s2 and enforces actual vector <=0.12 m/s; keep cancel envelope limited to tested trigger window. Do not use 0.5 m/s default.

matrix.limit: Short 3D/yaw only; native dwell is 1 sim s and evaluator reports wall seconds, not the GOAL F continuous 3 sim seconds.
matrix.decision: Reuse 3 old passes and failure; no repeat of old profile. N10.4 aligns native dwell and independent fixed-SE3 truth check to >=3 continuous simulation seconds.

risk_decisions.issue: N02/#332 cost and #04/#05 receipt-age causes unresolved.
risk_decisions.action: Keep gates; fail closed; never count failure as pass.

risk_decisions.issue: official_ego permits raw unknown not marked inflated occupied.
risk_decisions.action: Preserve raw label and inflated-occupied predicate; no unseen-space claim; independent truth/contact and formal obstacle runs.

risk_decisions.issue: 16 m/600 sim s exceeds existing N01 8.4 m/344.8 s and N09 0.4 m support.
risk_decisions.action: N10.3 long one-way low-speed task plus extended active observation; N16 remains formal.

risk_decisions.issue: Default 16 m route uses unqualified 0.5 m/s; evidence uses 0.1 m/s axis cap.
risk_decisions.action: Use measured low-speed planner, enforce vector <=0.12 m/s; faster speed needs new calibration.

risk_decisions.issue: 1 s native dwell and wall-time independent arrival metric do not establish GOAL F.
risk_decisions.action: Use <=0.30 m, <=15 deg and >=3.0 continuous simulation seconds in the shared configuration/evaluator.

risk_decisions.issue: Goal sim-time timeout vs client timeout_s+4 wall can cancel early if RTF<1.
risk_decisions.action: N10.3 measures RTF; N10.4 uses wall watchdog conversion/margin without changing sim action timeout.

risk_decisions.issue: Current-policy end-to-end in-flight replan deadline not measured; N06 is planner-only.
risk_decisions.action: Capture map-update to replacement-trajectory on N10.6 route or bounded diagnostic, then freeze from the event chain.

risk_decisions.issue: N04 maximum surface residual 0.09535 m, map voxel 0.10 m; no prior threshold.
risk_decisions.action: Test <=0.10 m candidate; exact definition/evaluator and independent check remain before freeze.

risk_decisions.issue: N08 tracking max 0.08672 m vs current 0.15 m gate; body radius 0.48194 m; provisional uncertainty 0.24868 m.
risk_decisions.action: Test tracking <=0.15 m and actual clearance >=0.10 m using full body; avoid double counting, measure stop path separately.

risk_decisions.issue: minimum_occupancy_points has no current code consumer under official_ego.
risk_decisions.action: Remove from active goal profiles/tooling; preserve policy as only official unknown/occupied rule.

risk_decisions.issue: runtime manifest omits actual vendor patch sources and some installed share/config/evaluator/PX4 source inputs.
risk_decisions.action: Extend final manifest and fail closed on mismatch.

risk_decisions.issue: Portable image archive missing from locked path.
risk_decisions.action: Create/checksum exact final image bundle after clean build and update lock.

freeze_preconditions: N10.3 calibrates distance/time support, map/error terms, vector speed/time domains, and replan event deadline.
N10.4 implements one acceptance config and fail-closed evaluators with boundary/missing-data/identity/time-domain checks.
N10.5 clean fetch/build from actual final candidate and locked dependencies.
N10.6 verifies installed parameters/graph, official_ego, PX4 mission, final metrics and affected regressions.
reused_passes_not_retested: N01-N09 limited historical exits retain original identity/scope.
N07 cumulative 3 successful starts are not repeated because no PX4 clock code changes.
N08 3 terminal stops reused only at measured low speed.
N09 3 old-profile successes retained; repeat03 fail preserved.
next_subtask: N10.3 independent calibration and quantitative acceptance rationale
